# poweradmin_zone_metadata_entries (Data Source)

Lists every PowerDNS metadata kind of a zone with its values. Requires Poweradmin 4.3.0+.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every metadata kind of a zone with its values
data "poweradmin_zone_metadata_entries" "example" {
  zone_id = 10
}

output "metadata" {
  value = { for e in data.poweradmin_zone_metadata_entries.example.entries : e.kind => e.values }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (Number) ID of the zone

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Metadata kinds of the zone, sorted by kind; empty when the zone has no metadata (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) The zone ID

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) Metadata kind, e.g. `ALLOW-AXFR-FROM`
- `values` (List of String) Values of the kind
